children: Acadia Healthcare secured preliminary court approval of a settlement providing a $12,000,000 insurer-paid cash payment and corporate governance reforms.
Preliminary Approval Order issued for settlement of derivative actions involving former/current individual defendants.
Cash Payment: $12,000,000 to be paid by Defendants’ Side A‑DIC insurers to Acadia for the company’s benefit.
Corporate Governance Reforms: agreed reforms (Exhibit A) to be adopted and maintained for at least four years.
Attorneys’ fees and expenses: $4,750,000 agreed to be paid to Plaintiffs’ Counsel, subject to court approval.
Upon final approval, derivative actions will be dismissed with prejudice and Released Claims broadly released.
